Due to a permanent infrastructure limitation, no direct corridor exists between Center Alpha and Center Beta. Furthermore, a routing regulation stipulates that exactly one of two critical links must be incorporated into the circuit: either the corridor between Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a route that visits every distribution center precisely one time, concluding at the initial point of departure.
